Identify every distinct sub-question, request, or implicit follow-up intent (e.g., 'tell me more', 'that project') present across the entire exchange.

For each identified part, locate where in the conversation (any turn) it was addressed, and check whether it was answered fully, briefly, or not at all, then assign the ## Coverage score (1-5) based on how many parts were addressed and how proportionately.
Re-read the full set of answers given and judge whether a visitor would come away meaningfully informed, checking for filler, deflection, or questions bounced back without substance.

Assess the level of detail and clarity of the substantive content provided, noting whether it is buried in preamble/repetition or presented cleanly, to assign the ## Usefulness of the answer score (1-5).
Check whether the response leaves an obvious next step or question for the visitor, which is required for the top score (5) on ## Usefulness of the answer.
Cross-check that the ## Coverage score and ## Usefulness of the answer score are each justified by specific evidence from the conversation, not assumed from tone or effort alone.
